note: Grounded in kg_schema.md SS1/SS4 (patient_key_ref not patient_key; SensitiveSegment access-group check) and PRIVACY_AND_PSEUDONYMISATION.md (K-020).

scenarios.description: A response references case PV-1001 using patient_key_ref, never the raw patient_key.
Adversarial: raw patient_key value leaked into a response field -- a direct KG-schema violation (kg_schema.md SS1).
Case PV-1020 has a 'pregnancy' sensitive_segment restricted to access_group PV_PREGNANCY. A caller without that access group must not receive the segment.
LOCAL_WORK_INSTRUCTION_DE.md (K-016, jurisdiction=DE) is cited for a query correctly scoped to DE -- fully citable within jurisdiction.
Adversarial: K-016 cited for a query scoped outside DE -- a jurisdiction-local document must not be treated as globally citable.

Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-059): a rare-disease genomic dataset carries no raw patient_key but combines region + age-band + sex + rare-diagnosis -- 4 quasi-identifiers, exceeding the safe combination threshold even though pseudonymised.
Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-060): EU trial data's consent scope covers safety-signal analysis only; a request to reuse it for cross-border commercial model training is outside that scope.
Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-063): biomarker data licensed for research use only; considering it for commercial targeting is outside the license scope -- same rule as PCB-07, different domain.
Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-064): a backup replica of a regulated record lands in a region not on the approved list (ADR-009's residency requirement, made verifiable).
Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-062): patient-support-programme free text declared for adverse-event intake only contains financial-hardship and family-member details beyond that purpose.
Golden companion to PCB-10: a patient-support case whose free text stays within its declared purpose.

Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-068): a crafted query bundles PV-1020 (pregnancy-restricted, caller lacks PV_PREGNANCY) alongside two cases the caller IS authorized for, attempting to exfiltrate the restricted narrative by hiding it in a bulk request.
